zoe_cs: Morning — NexaCorp weekly health check. Headline: total requests steady, 5xx +2.4% WoW, timeouts +5.9% (nightly imports & batch transforms), 429s small bump during region peak. Listing top failing endpoints + short notes.
carl_sre: please post top 5 URIs and spike windows.
zoe_cs: sure — quick list: 
- POST /api/v2/transform/batch — timeouts 2.8% on large transforms, spike 02:10-03:00 UTC (nightly import overlap)
- POST /v1/batch-embed — timeouts ~2.1% on batches >30, spike 13:20-14:05 UTC
- POST /ingest/files/upload — intermittent timeouts 0.6% tied to big file uploads (01:30-02:00 UTC)
- POST /chat/live/stream — rate_limit (429) increase to 0.7% during 18:00-18:30 local peak
- POST /internal/retry-proxy — 5xx 0.5% correlated with client retry storms
mira_prod: FYI we rolled a change that increases default batch size for enterprise accounts last week; that likely amplifies transform and embed load.
carl_sre: infra notes: short GPU preemption event at 02:12 UTC on dedicated pool + transient IO queueing on ingest nodes around 01:40 UTC. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/nexacorp/errors?from=now-7d&to=now
carl_sre: quick local repro for batch-embed timeout (use --max-time to simulate client timeout):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/batch-embed \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"items": ["<long text>"], "model":"embed-pro"}' --max-time 12
```
oliver_pm: renewal touch in 5 days. Is this a material risk?
zoe_cs: status = medium. Not at contractual SLA breach yet but customer called out "sporadic failures" in ops call. Proposed actions:
- immediate: edge soft-throttle for transform/batch-embed >20 items (owner: carl_sre)
- 48h: offer SDK chunking guidance + opt-in rollback for larger default batch (owner: mira_prod)
- 1 week: schedule temporary capacity bump for dedicated pool during 01:30-03:30 UTC (owner: zoe_cs)
carl_sre: will open gateway throttle PR and canary today; will post link. Also enabling extra alerting for preempt events.
mira_prod: will draft SDK guidance and coordinate DevEx for the opt-in by 48h.
alerts-bot: alert: NexaCorp 5xx threshold breached (last 1h = 44, threshold = 30)
zoe_cs: action items: carl_sre (throttle + PR, due today COB), mira_prod (SDK guidance, due 48h), zoe_cs (renewal brief + customer note, due before meeting). I'll share customer-facing summary after canary is green. :thumbsup:
